svg.title: 45. Sole of foot stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Sit and rest one ankle across the other thigh. Hold the heel with one hand. Use the other hand at the base of the toes to bend them gently towards your shin.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.orthoinfo.org/diseases--conditions/plantar-fasciitis-and-bone-spurs/
